propositions.name: bodies_at_distance_set_in_motion
propositions.statement: Bodies in certain electrical or magnetical states set each other in motion while still at a sensible distance from each other.
propositions.quote: bodies in certain states set each other in motion while still at a sensible distance from each other

propositions.name: force_depends_on_position_and_state
propositions.statement: The force acting between bodies depends on the relative position of the bodies and on their electric or magnetic condition.
propositions.quote: this force depends in a certain way upon the relative position of the bodies and on their electric or magnetic condition

propositions.name: weber_particles_act_at_distance
propositions.statement: Some theories assume the existence of substances whose particles act on one another at a distance by attraction or repulsion.
propositions.quote: the existence of substances the particles of which have the property of acting on one another at a distance by attraction or repulsion

propositions.name: weber_force_depends_on_velocity
propositions.statement: In this kind of theory the force between two particles depends on their relative velocity as well as on their distance.
propositions.quote: the force between two particles depends on their relative velocity, as well as on their distance

propositions.name: reject_action_at_distance_as_ultimate
propositions.statement: The assumption of particles acting at a distance with forces depending on their velocities cannot be considered an ultimate theory.
propositions.quote: such as to prevent me from considering this theory as an ultimate one though it may have been, and may yet be useful

propositions.name: actions_in_surrounding_medium
propositions.statement: Electric and magnetic phenomena are produced by actions which go on in the surrounding medium as well as in the excited bodies.
propositions.quote: supposing them to be produced by actions which go on in the surrounding medium as well as in the excited bodies

propositions.name: field_is_matter_in_motion
propositions.statement: In the space of the electromagnetic field there is matter in motion, by which the observed electromagnetic phenomena are produced.
propositions.quote: it assumes that in that space there is matter in motion, by which the observed electromagnetic phenomena are produced

propositions.name: field_defined_as_surrounding_space
propositions.statement: The electromagnetic field is that part of space which contains and surrounds bodies in electric or magnetic conditions.
propositions.quote: The electromagnetic field is that part of space which contains and surrounds bodies in electric or magnetic conditions.

propositions.name: undulations_are_ethereal_not_gross_matter
propositions.statement: The undulations of light and heat are undulations of an ethereal substance and not of the gross matter.
propositions.quote: we are obliged to admit that the undulations are those of an ethereal substance, and not of the gross matter

propositions.name: ethereal_medium_fills_space
propositions.statement: There is an ethereal medium filling space and permeating bodies, capable of being set in motion and of transmitting that motion from one part to another.
propositions.quote: there is an ethereal medium filling space and permeating bodies, capable of being set in motion and of transmitting that motion from one part to another

propositions.name: medium_communicates_motion_to_gross_matter
propositions.statement: The ethereal medium is capable of communicating motion to gross matter so as to heat it and affect it in various ways.
propositions.quote: of communicating that motion to gross matter so as to heat it and affect it in various ways

propositions.name: heat_energy_preexisted_in_medium
propositions.statement: The energy communicated to a body in heating it must have formerly existed in the moving medium.
propositions.quote: the energy communicated to the body in heating it must have formerly existed in the moving medium

propositions.name: medium_has_density_comparable_to_gross_matter
propositions.statement: The medium must have a density capable of comparison with that of gross matter.
propositions.quote: the medium must have a density capable of comparison with that of gross matter

propositions.name: medium_has_finite_velocity_of_transmission
propositions.statement: The pervading medium is capable of being set in motion and of transmitting motion from one part to another with great, but not infinite, velocity.
propositions.quote: capable of being set in motion, and of transmitting motion from one part to another with great, but not infinite, velocity

propositions.name: parts_of_medium_interconnected
propositions.statement: The parts of the medium must be so connected that the motion of one part depends in some way on the motion of the rest.
propositions.quote: the parts of this medium must be so connected that the motion of one part depends in some way on the motion of the rest

propositions.name: connections_elastically_yielding
propositions.statement: The connections between parts of the medium must be capable of a certain kind of elastic yielding since the communication of motion is not instantaneous.
propositions.quote: these connections must be capable of a certain kind of elastic yielding, since the communication of motion is not instantaneous, but occupies time

propositions.name: medium_stores_two_energy_forms
propositions.statement: The medium is capable of receiving and storing up actual energy depending on the motions of its parts and potential energy consisting of the work the medium does in recovering from displacement.
propositions.quote: The medium is therefore capable of receiving and storing up two kinds of energy, namely, the “actual” energy depending on the motions of its parts, and “potential” energy

propositions.name: undulation_propagation_transforms_energy
propositions.statement: The propagation of undulations consists in the continual transformation of one form of energy into the other, and at any instant the energy in the whole medium is equally divided between motion and elastic resilience.
propositions.quote: at any instant the amount of energy in the whole medium is equally divided, so that half is energy of motion, and half is elastic resilience

propositions.name: magnetism_acts_on_luminiferous_medium
propositions.statement: The luminiferous medium is in certain cases acted on by magnetism.
propositions.quote: we know that the luminiferous medium is in certain cases acted on by magnetism

propositions.name: magnetic_rotation_of_polarization_plane
propositions.statement: When a plane polarized ray traverses a transparent diamagnetic medium in the direction of the lines of magnetic force, the plane of polarization is caused to rotate.
propositions.quote: when a plane polarized ray traverses a transparent diamagnetic medium in the direction of the lines of magnetic force produced by magnets or currents in the neighbourhood, the plane of polarization is caused to rotate

propositions.name: paramagnetic_rotation_opposite_direction
propositions.statement: When a paramagnetic body is substituted for the diamagnetic body, the rotation of the plane of polarization is in the opposite direction.
propositions.quote: if a paramagnetic body, such as solution of perchloride of iron in ether, be substituted for the diamagnetic body, the rotation is in the opposite direction

propositions.name: medium_motion_depends_on_magnetization
propositions.statement: There must be admitted a motion in the medium depending on the magnetization, in addition to the vibratory motion which constitutes light.
propositions.quote: we must admit the existence of a motion in the medium depending on the magnetization, in addition to the vibratory motion which constitutes light

propositions.name: magnetic_motion_is_rotation
propositions.statement: The motion of the ethereal medium under magnetic effects is one of rotation, having the direction of the magnetic force as its axis.
propositions.quote: we have some reason to suppose that this motion is one of rotation, having the direction of the magnetic force as its axis

propositions.name: motion_across_lines_causes_electromotive_force
propositions.statement: When a body is moved across the lines of magnetic force it experiences what is called an electromotive force.
propositions.quote: When a body is moved across the lines of magnetic force it experiences what is called an electromotive force

propositions.name: electromotive_force_decomposes_compounds
propositions.statement: When sufficiently powerful and acting on certain compound bodies, electromotive force decomposes them and causes their components to pass in opposite directions.
propositions.quote: it decomposes them, and causes one of their components to pass towards on extremity of the body, and the other in the opposite direction

propositions.name: electric_polarization_state_of_constraint
propositions.statement: Electric polarization is a state of constraint in which opposite extremities of a body are oppositely electrified, from which the body tends to relieve itself as soon as the disturbing force is removed.
propositions.quote: a state of constraint in which opposite extremities are oppositely electrified, and from which the body tends to relieve itself as soon as the disturbing force is removed

propositions.name: electromotive_force_is_medium_motion_communication
propositions.statement: Electromotive force is the force called into play during the communication of motion from one part of the medium to another.
propositions.quote: this "electromotive force" is the force called into play during the communication of motion from one part of the medium to another

propositions.name: resistance_converts_electrical_energy_to_heat_irreversibly
propositions.statement: When electromotive force produces a current that meets with resistance, this occasions a continual transformation of electrical energy into heat which is incapable of being restored again to electrical energy by reversal of the process.
propositions.quote: occasions a continual transformation of electrical energy into heat, which is incapable of being restored again to the form of electrical energy by an reversal of the process

propositions.name: dielectric_polarization_similar_to_magnet
propositions.statement: When electromotive force acts on a dielectric it produces a state of polarization of its parts similar in distribution to the polarity of the parts of a mass of iron under the influence of a magnet.
propositions.quote: it produces a state of polarization of its parts similar in distribution to the polarity of the parts of a mass of iron under the influence of a magnet

propositions.name: electricity_displaced_within_molecule
propositions.statement: In a dielectric under electromotive force, the electricity in each molecule is displaced so that one side is positively and the other negatively electrical, while the electricity remains connected with the molecule and does not pass from one molecule to another.
propositions.quote: the electricity in each molecule is so displaced that one side is rendered positively and the other negatively electrical, but that the electricity remains entirely connected with the molecule, and does not pass from one molecule to another

propositions.name: electric_displacement_is_elastic_yielding
propositions.statement: Electric displacement is a kind of elastic yielding to the action of electromotive force.
propositions.quote: electric displacement, which according to our theory is a kind of elastic yielding to the action of the force

propositions.name: electric_absorption_gradual_change
propositions.statement: In electric absorption, the electric displacement gradually increases under electromotive force, and when the force is removed the dielectric does not instantly return to its primitive state but only discharges a portion of its electrification.
propositions.quote: the electric displacement gradually increases, and when the electromotive force is removed, the dielectric does not instantly return to its primitive state, but only discharges a portion of its electrification

propositions.name: medium_set_in_motion_by_currents_and_magnets
propositions.statement: The parts of the ethereal medium are capable of being set in motion by electric currents and magnets.
propositions.quote: the parts of this medium are capable of being set in motion by electric currents and magnets

propositions.name: mechanism_subject_to_dynamics
propositions.statement: The complicated mechanism of connected moving parts constituting the medium must be subject to the general laws of Dynamics.
propositions.quote: Such a mechanism must be subject to the general laws of Dynamics, and we ought to be able to work out all the consequences of its motion

propositions.name: current_produces_magnetic_properties_in_field
propositions.statement: When an electric current is established in a conducting circuit, the neighbouring part of the field is characterized by certain magnetic properties.
propositions.quote: when an electric current is established in a conducting circuit, the neighbouring part of the field is characterized by certain magnetic properties

propositions.name: only_transverse_disturbances_propagated
propositions.statement: The only magnetic disturbances which can be propagated through a non-conductive field are those which are transverse to the direction of propagation.
propositions.quote: it is shown that the only disturbances which can be so propagated are those which are transverse to the direction of propagation

propositions.name: velocity_of_propagation_equals_electrical_ratio
propositions.statement: The velocity of propagation of the magnetic disturbance is the velocity found from experiments which expresses the number of electrostatic units of electricity contained in one electromagnetic unit.
propositions.quote: the velocity of propagation is the velocity v , found from experiments such as those of Weber , which expresses the number of electrostatic units of electricity which are contained in one electromagnetic unit

propositions.name: light_is_electromagnetic_disturbance
propositions.statement: Light itself, including radiant heat and other radiations, is an electromagnetic disturbance in the form of waves propagated through the electromagnetic field according to electromagnetic laws.
propositions.quote: light itself (including radiant heat, and other radiations if any) is an electromagnetic disturbance in the form of waves propagated through the electromagnetic field according to electromagnetic laws

propositions.name: refraction_index_equals_capacity_product
propositions.statement: The square of the index of refraction is equal to the product of the specific dielectric capacity and the specific magnetic capacity.
propositions.quote: the square of the index of refraction is equal to the product of the specific dielectric capacity and the specific magnetic capacity

propositions.name: conducting_media_are_opaque
propositions.statement: Conducting media absorb radiations rapidly and are therefore generally opaque.
propositions.quote: Conducting media are shown to absorb such radiations rapidly, and therefore to be generally opaque.
